content.title: Dunkin’ will give away 1M free coffees on April Fools’ Day
content.text: DiningDunkin’ brings back its April Fools’ free coffee—this time with 1,000,001 cups up for grabs.Courtesy of Dunkin' DonutsBy Pamela Silvestri | silvestri@siadvance.comSTATEN ISLAND, N.Y. — April Fools’ Day comes with a free coffee at Dunkin’, and this time, there’s no catch.On Wednesday, April 1, Dunkin’ Rewards members can score a free hot or iced coffee, while supplies last, by entering the promo code STILLNOTAJOKE in the Dunkin’ app. The giveaway marks the return of the brand’s popular April Fools’ promotion after last year’s one-million-cup giveaway, with Dunkin’ offering 1,000,001 free coffees nationwide this time around.The promotion arrives as Dunkin’ continues to rebuild momentum across Staten Island—from neighborhood store remodels in Rosebank and Woodrow to the restoration of coffee service in the Staten Island Ferry system.In early February, Dunkin’ opened a long-awaited location inside the St. George Ferry Terminal, filling the space previously occupied by Au Bon Pain. The shop operates daily from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. and includes a walk-up window that opens directly into the terminal, making it a quick stop for commuters during peak rush hours.Cold brew with milk stays darker than regular iced coffee, usually a caramel or mocha shade.Courtesy of Dunkin' DonutsThe ferry terminal opening follows other recent Dunkin’ expansions tied to the city’s busiest commuter route. Dunkin’ first debuted at the Whitehall Terminal in Manhattan in 2018 with mobile ordering and a cold-brew tap system. The brand returned onboard in December 2024 with a café on the Staff Sgt. Michael H. Ollis ferryboat, restoring coffee service at sea after nearly four years.On Staten Island, Dunkin’ has also refreshed neighborhood storefronts, including a newly remodeled location at 1131 Bay St. in Rosebank, which reopened with the brand’s Next Generation’ design, an eight-beverage tap system and daily hours from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. That reopening was marked by a $3,000 donation to Community Health Action of Staten Island from franchisee The Shree Group through the Dunkin’ Joy in Childhood Foundation.Dunkin’ Donuts opened in the Staten Island Ferry terminal in Feb. 2026 following a long vacancy of its now-home storefront.(Advance/SILive.com | Pamela Silvestri)The April Fools’ giveaway coincides with Dunkin’s spring menu rollout, which introduces several limited-time drinks and treats, many featuring banana and berry flavors. New items include the Banana Puddin’ Cloud Latte, Berry Acai Refresher, Blueberry Pie Matcha and Dunkin’ Zero, a zero-sugar energy drink available in six flavors. A $6 meal deal—a medium hot or iced coffee, bacon egg and cheese sandwich, and hash browns—remains available for a limited time.For Staten Island commuters and coffee regulars, April 1 offers a rare April Fools’ promise that delivers exactly what it advertises.After flood shut it down for months, bakery reopens on Staten Island1 Staten Island Applebee’s location closes after 20 yearsThere’s a seat for everyone.
